gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with history of glioblastoma are diagnosed with recurrent glioblastoma and residual tumor after intracranial tumor resection/biopsy performed in Beijing Tiantan Hospital.

candidate_evidence.quote: Inverse correlated dual-target, truncated IL7Ra modified CAR -expressing autologous T-lymphocytes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tris-CAR-T Cell Therapy for Recurrent Glioblastoma

agents.agent_name_registered: Inverse correlated dual-target, truncated IL7Ra modified CAR -expressing autologous T-lymphocytes.

role_evidence.quote: The autologous Tris-CAR-T cell, targeting both CD44 and CD133, the two inverse correlated targets, introduced truncated IL7Ra to the intracellular domain of the CAR molecule

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous CD44/CD133 dual-target CAR-T cells (Tris-CAR-T), locoregional via Ommaya reservoir
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: CAR-T cells targeting CD44 and CD133

source_quote.quote: if tissue samples from multiple time points are available, also evaluate the degree of target expression, biological characteristics of samples at diagnosis versus at recurrence or progression.

coder_notes: Sole intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (excluded type). CSF/blood CAR-T kinetics (qPCR) and CSF cytokine pharmacodynamics are planned but relate to the non-candidate cell therapy, so tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no. Supportive care (glucocorticoids, antibiotics, cytokine antagonists) mentioned only generically, not registered interventions, so not listed.
